groups.name: Men's waxing
groups.intro: The male Brazilian is no longer something to wonder about. Here's a step-by-step guide to waxing, below the boxers and everywhere else.

items.q: How should I prepare for my wax?
items.a:
- **Be clean.** Come freshly showered.
- **Be dry.** Skip lotion and oils that day. Wax grips better on skin that isn't oily.
- **Be a little hairy.** Hair should be at least ¼ inch long, so don't shave for about three weeks before. If things have gotten out of control, don't worry: your technician will trim longer hair first.
- **Be comfortable.** Wear loose clothing to avoid irritation afterward.
- **Be relaxed.** The more relaxed your muscles, the better your results.

items.q: What happens during the appointment?
items.a:
- **Privacy.** You'll undress in a private treatment room. For a Brazilian you'll remove your underwear, which protects your clothes and lets your technician get every unwanted hair.
- **Prep.** Your technician cleanses the area to remove bacteria from the skin.
- **Consultation.** They check hair length, trim as needed, and ask where you'd like to keep hair and how much.
- **Waxing.** The main event.
- **Fine-tuning.** You'll get a mirror to approve your new look, and any stray hairs are tidied.
- **Done.** Get dressed and get on with your day.

items.q: Why do men get a Brazilian or body wax?
items.a:
- To skip the itchy five o'clock shadow that comes with shaving and get a longer-lasting, smoother result.
- Swimmers, athletes and bodybuilders often remove body hair, especially before competition.
- Personal preference. Plenty of guys simply prefer how it looks and feels.

groups.name: Facials & back facials
groups.intro: Facials matter for everyone's skin. Here's how to get the most from yours.

items.q: How should I prepare for a facial?
items.a:
**Come with bare skin.** Wash off your products or skip your skincare routine that morning, except sunscreen. On a first facial especially, this makes it easy to tell whether any irritation comes from the treatment.

**Skip retinol and other strong actives.** Retinol removes dead skin cells and can cause dryness, redness and irritation. Combined with facial treatments it can trigger a stronger reaction.

items.q: What does a facial do for my skin?
items.a:
- **Unclogs and refines pores.** Oil, dirt and larger pores lead to blackheads and breakouts. A facial clears them and helps prevent further problems.
- **Smoother shaving.** Treatments calm razor burn and irritation, and exfoliation helps release ingrown hairs before they become bumps.
- **Skin care education.** Your esthetician learns your skin and recommends treatments, products and how to use them.

items.q: How long does it take?
items.a: Our Purifying Back & Butt Facial comes in 60- and 90-minute versions. [Placeholder: times for other facials.]

items.q: What should I do after my facial?
items.a: Ask your esthetician which products suit your skin concerns and what routine to follow at home. A regular routine after a facial keeps results going longer.
